name: Hoshikage no Diamond ~Ao Yoru no Kizuna~
original_name: 星影のダイヤモンド～青夜の絆～
source:
-My love for stars won't bring you before me, but the bond of constellations gave me a different-

This is a dating simulator depicting a gradual growth of a pastry chef, 
who is the protagonist of the story, with regular customers of her shop.
